breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still applies a half-shift Monkhorst-Pack grid for the nscf step ('automatic Monkhorst-Pack grid of 10x10x10 with a half shift (0.5 0.5 0.5) as specified for electronic sampling'), directly repeating the erroneous instruction from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth resolves this contradiction by removing the half-shift requirement entirely and specifying only a gamma-centered k-point grid throughout.
